Bank Passbook Document Requirements.
These guidelines define the mandatory information and validation rules required for bank passbook data extraction.
Global Data Entry Rules.
Data Type — All extracted values must be returned as strings.
Sanitization — Trim all leading and trailing whitespaces.
Null Handling — Return as null if not present or illegible.
Bank Details Requirements.
Bank Name — Required in full and UPPERCASE.
Branch Name — Required in UPPERCASE.
Branch Code — Required as numeric or alphanumeric string.
IFSC Code — Required in 11-character format.
MICR Code — Required as exactly 9-digit numeric string.
Branch Email — Required in standard email format.
Branch Phone — Required as numbers only.
Business Hours — Required in 24-hour time range format.
Customer Details Requirements.
Name — Required exactly as printed.
Guardian Name — Required exactly as printed.
CIF Number — Required strictly numeric.
Address — Required as a single continuous string.
PAN — Required in 10-character standard format.
Account Details Requirements.
Account Number — Required strictly numeric.
Account Type — Required in UPPERCASE predefined categories.
Mode of Operation — Required in predefined operational modes.
Account Opening Date — Required in DD/MM/YYYY or ISO 8601 format.
Date of Issue — Required in DD/MM/YYYY or ISO 8601 format.
Nominee Registration Number — Required as exact alphanumeric string.
